title: I Have a Headache

lines.text: Hello, Sam. What's the problem?
I have a headache, doctor. And I'm very tired.
Do you drink a lot of water?
No, I don't. I drink juice and cola.
Do you sleep well?
No. I go to bed at midnight and I get up at six.
I see. Drink two litres of water every day. Go to bed at ten o'clock.
OK. Do I need medicine?
Take one tablet after lunch. Come back on Friday if you still have a headache.
Thank you, doctor.

title: My Morning Routine

lines.text: My name is Daniel and I get up at six thirty.

I have breakfast at seven o'clock. I usually eat eggs and bread, and I drink a glass of milk.
At seven thirty, I brush my teeth and take my school bag.
I walk to school with my brother. It takes fifteen minutes.
School starts at eight o'clock. I'm never late!
On Saturdays, I get up late, at nine o'clock. I love Saturdays!
